title: ₹4,000 Crore Fake Offer Scam? Jio , Zomato, Blinkit & Flipkart Are Fooling You Online
description:
Install Buyhatke -your AI shopping assistant to compare prices, track drops & save smartly.: https://e.buyhatke.com/GenZway


I ordered a phone from a well-known online platform… and what I found wasn’t just an empty box —
it exposed a ₹4,000 crore scam happening right under our noses.

In this video, I break down how major online brands and platforms like Reliance, Zomato, Blinkit, Zepto, Uber, and Flipkart are fooling millions of customers with fake offers, misleading deals, and loopholes in their return and refund systems.

This isn’t just about one empty box.
This is about:

⸻

🔥 1. The ₹4,000 Crore Fake Offer Scam

Fake discounts, manipulated prices, “70% off,” “flash sales,” “limited time deals” —
and how these offers trick people into buying low-quality or wrong products.

⸻

🛒 2. How Big Brands Are Exploiting Online Shoppers
 • Empty box scams
 • Used or fake products being delivered
 • No-questions-asked “refund tricks”
 • Manipulated MRP to show fake discounts
 • App-only sales that increase price artificially

These scams are happening at scale, and customers don’t even realize it.

⸻

📦 3. Why Customer Support Doesn’t Help

From “file a complaint” to “wait 72 hours,” these platforms delay, confuse, or push the burden on customers — knowing most people will eventually give up.

⸻

📉 4. The Dark Business Model Behind These Offers

We expose how:
 • Massive return fraud
 • Third-party sellers
 • Warehouse manipulation
 • Fake listings
 • Misleading ads

…all contribute to India’s biggest online shopping scams.

⸻

🕵️ 5. What You Should NEVER Do While Shopping Online

At the end of the video, I share the 5 mistakes people make that allow these scams to grow into a ₹4,000 crore problem.
